questions.question: A spaza owner buys stock for R12 650 and sells it all for R15 230. Find the profit and check your answer.
questions.expected_answer: Profit is selling price minus cost price: R15 230 minus R12 650 is R2 580. Check: R12 650 plus R2 580 is R15 230.

questions.question: An odometer reads 45 678 km at the start of a trip and 47 123 km at the end. How far was the trip?
questions.expected_answer: 47 123 minus 45 678 is 1 445, so the trip was 1 445 km. Check: 45 678 plus 1 445 is 47 123.

questions.question: A family earns R18 500 a month and spends R6 750 on rent, R4 380 on food and R2 465 on transport. How much is left? Show both steps.
questions.expected_answer: Step one: total spending is R6 750 plus R4 380 plus R2 465, which is R13 595. Step two: R18 500 minus R13 595 is R4 905. R4 905 is left each month.
